findings.text: non-blocking: the runner's require_successor re-implements the successor-edge postcondition that _verify_postconditions already asserts (the same check is what makes 07-reapply.log report already_applied) instead of extending the owner, so the repository now carries two copies of the assertion; the node's write fence excludes imas_codex/, so a shared reader needs a section that owns product code.

non-blocking: the pre-repair revert arm records its header and a bare EXIT=0 with no payload between them, so the log evidences an exit code but not that the pre-repair runner read the live graph and printed the state it saw.

non-blocking: the gate log's revision header names 0956b225f because the repaired runner was still uncommitted when the log was written, so a reader pairing the manifest's tests line with f3c4dd259 cannot tell from the log which runner produced its EXIT=0 (05b-readback.log:1 carries the same mismatch).

item_verdicts.done_when: read §48's done-when and the prompt's FENCE-EVIDENCE against 06-gate.log and 05b-readback.log; the gate named in the manifest's tests line now runs checked_gate, which calls require_successor before the export-blocking-set measurement, so the stated measure is asserted instead of only printed.
item_verdicts.goal: read the node goal against the run prompt and 05b-readback.log; one receipt-stamped HAS_SUCCESSOR edge from flux_surface_average_magnetic_field_magnitude to flux_surface_averaged_magnetic_field_magnitude is recorded, and the gained commit adds the assertion that keeps that state measurable.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 0956b225f and f3c4dd259, names the gate command in tests, names 06-gate.log/05b-readback.log/07-reapply.log plus both negation arms in test_logs, and answers all six rubric dimensions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; the diff of 0956b225f..f3c4dd259 touches only sib-magnetic-successor-edge-run.py and sib-magnetic-successor-edge.html, both inside the four declared paths, and leaves the authority JSON untouched.

justifications.durability: sib-magnetic-successor-edge-run.py:259-304 raises SystemExit naming each violated clause, and deleting the HAS_SUCCESSOR edge would drive successor_edges at line 269 to 0 and redden it; 09-negctl-negated-expectation.log shows the clauses firing.

justifications.fit: the added helpers follow the module's existing mode-plus-JSON idiom at sib-magnetic-successor-edge-run.py:364-386, and the change also removes the duplicate sourceless_live_ids key and the noqa that suppressed nothing at line 342.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the edge the goal names is read back at 05b-readback.log:41-52 with successor_edges 1 and receipt sn-change:signed-manifest:8f25a71f...:43f44939, and the gained commit adds the guard rather than a second write.
justifications.reuse: require_successor at sib-magnetic-successor-edge-run.py:259 duplicates the edge-count, receipt-id and successor-id postcondition already asserted at imas_codex/standard_names/signed_manifest.py:4258 without calling or extending that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff of f3c4dd259 touches sib-magnetic-successor-edge-run.py and sib-magnetic-successor-edge.html only, both inside the declared paths at prompt.txt FENCE-SCOPE, and neither the authority JSON nor any other file changes.
